description: RBKC Parking Bay Locations is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. This dataset contains a list of all Pay & Display, Blue Badge, Motor Bike, Car Club (both City Car Club and Zip Car) parking bays within the boundaries of the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, London. Coverage: Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The portal files it under the publisher Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It offers 2 resource(s) in KML, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
